During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''captain''' was stationed on the [[Ocean/Legends|water]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Spira/Legends|Spira]]. Assigned to command a modified [[Snopps' Touring Vessel|waveskimmer]] to escort [[Regenald Hanniper Snopps III]] to [[the wreck]], a local tourist attraction, the captain followed orders but did not much care for the young [[Noble/Legends|noble]].
